book.name: Mɑteu
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Kurɔ kpɑɑrun dim ɡɑri
Yesu kpɑm kɑ bu mɔndu ɡɑri sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
n wee, ye Gusunɔn bɑndun ɡɑri kɑ weenɛ. Sunɔ ɡoo u win biin kurɔ kpɑɑrun sɔɔru kuɑ.
U win sɔmɔbu ɡɔrɑ bu dɑ bu be bɑ dim sokɑ sokumɑ. Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ kĩ bu nɑ.
Mɑ u kpɑm win sɔmɔbu ɡɑbu ɡɔrɑ u nɛɛ, i doo i be nɑ dim sokɑ sɔ̃ nɑ sɔɔru kpɑ, nɑ nɛn nɑɑ kinɛnu kɑ yɑɑ sɑbe ɡumɡinu ɡo. Ye kpuro yɑ sɔɔru kpeerɑ, bu nɑ kurɔ kpɑɑ yerɔ.
Adɑmɑ be bɑ dim sokɑ mi, bɑ ǹ ɡɑri yi swɑɑ sue mɑ bɑɑwure u wiɡiru doonɑ, wini win ɡberu dɑ, wini mɑɑ win tenkuru doonɑ.
Ben ɡɑbɑ sɔmɔ be mwɑ bɑ nɔni sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ ɡo.
Sunɔ wi, u mɔru bɛsirɑ u win tɑbu kowobu ɡɔrɑ bu kɑ tɔn ɡowo be ɡo kpɑ bu ben wuu dɔ̃ɔ sɔku.
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ u win sɔmɔbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, kurɔ kpɑɑ dĩɑnu ye, ɑdɑmɑ be nɑ sokɑ bɑ ǹ mɑɑ kɑ nu weenɛ.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, i doo swɑɑ swɑɑbu i be i wɑɑmɔ sokumɑ.
Mɑ sɔmɔ be, bɑ dɑ swɑɑ swɑɑbu bɑ be bɑ wɑ kpuro mɛnnɑ kɔ̃sobu kɑ ɡeobu. Nɡe mɛyɑ tɔmbɑ kɑ yibɑ kurɔ kpɑɑ yee te sɔɔ.
Ye sunɔ wi, u duɑ u kɑ bu wɑ be bɑ dim nɑ, u durɔ ɡoo wɑ wi u kun kurɔ kpɑɑ yɑ̃nu doke.
U nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɔrɔ, ɑmɔnɑ ɑ kuɑ ɑ kɑ duumɑ mini ɑ ǹ kɑ kurɔ kpɑɑ yɑ̃nu doke. Durɔ wi kun ɡɛɛ wisɑ.
Yerɑ sunɔ wi, u win sɔm kowobu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i win nɔmɑ kɑ nɑɑsu bɔkuo kpɑ i nùn kɑsɑ ko yɑm wɔ̃kuru sɔɔ tɔɔwɔ, mi u koo wiru nɔmɑ sɔndi u swĩ.
Mɑ Yesu u nɛɛ, dɑbirɑ bɑ sokɑ ɑdɑmɑ fiikowɑ bɑ ɡɔsɑ.
Wɔ̃ɔ ɡobin kɔsiɑbun ɡɑri
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ Fɑlisibɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ mɛnnɑ bu kɑ kɑsu mɛ bɑ koo ko bu kɑ Yesu ɡɑrin yinɑ bɛriɑ.

Mɑ bɑ ben bwɑ̃ɑbu ɡɑbu kɑ Herodun tɔmbu ɡɑbu ɡɔrɑ win mi. Bɑ dɑ bɑ nɛɛ, yinni, sɑ yɛ̃ mɑ ɑ rɑ ɡem ɡere, mɑ ɑ tɔmbu Gusunɔn swɑɑ sɔ̃ɔsimɔ dee dee, mɛyɑ ɑ ku rɑ ɡoon nɔnu mɛɛri, domi ɑ ku rɑ ɡɑri ɡere binɛ kɑ bɛrum sɔ̃.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ sun sɔ̃ɔwɔ, yen mɛ ɑ wɑ. N weenɛ bu tem yɛ̃ro wɔ̃ɔ ɡobi kɔsiɑ? Nɡe n ǹ weenɛ.
Adɑmɑ Yesu u ben bwisi kɔ̃si yi yɛ̃ mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, murɑfiti bɛɛ! Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i kĩ i nɛn lɑɑkɑri mɛɛri.
I mɑn ɡobi yi sɔ̃ɔsio yi i rɑ kɑ wɔ̃ɔ ɡobi kɔsie. Mɑ bɑ nùn sii ɡeesun ɡobi sɔ̃ɔsi.
Mɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, weren foto kɑ yĩrerɑ mini.
Bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, tem yɛ̃roɡiɑ. Yerɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i tem yɛ̃ro kɔsio ye yɑ sɑ̃ɑ tem yɛ̃roɡiɑ, kpɑ i mɑɑ Gusunɔ kɔsiɑ ye yɑ sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔɡiɑ.
Ye bɑ ɡɑri yi nuɑ, bɑ biti soorɑ, mɑ bɑ nùn deri bɑ doonɑ.
Gɔribun seebun ɡɑri
Sɔ̃ɔ tee te sɔɔ, Sɑdusi be bɑ rɑ nɛɛ ɡɔribɑ kun seemɔ, ben ɡɑbɑ nɑ Yesun mi. Mɑ bɑ nùn bikiɑ
bɑ nɛɛ, tɔnwero, Mɔwisi nɛɛ, durɔ ɡoo ù n ɡu ù kun bii mɑrɑ, win wɔnɔwɑ koo win ɡɔmini yɛnu doke kpɑ u kɑ win mɔɔ bweseru seeyɑ.
N wee bɛsɛn suunu sɔɔ tundo turosibu nɔɔbɑ yiru ɡɑbɑ rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ. Gbiikoo kurɔ suɑ mɑ u ɡu u ǹ bii mɑrɑ, mɑ u win wɔnɔ ɡɔmini deriɑ.
Ben yirusen tii mɛyɑ, kɑ itɑse, sere kɑ nɔɔbɑ yiruseɔ.
Be kpuron biru kurɔ win tii mɑɑ ɡu.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, dɔmɑ te ɡɔribɑ koo se, tɔmbu nɔɔbɑ yiru ye sɔɔ, ben wɑrɑ ko n kurɔ wi mɔ, domi be kpuro bɑ nùn yɛ̃wɑ kurɔ.
Yesu bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, i tore yèn sɔ̃ i ǹ Gusunɔn ɡɑri yɛ̃, mɛyɑ i ǹ mɑɑ win dɑm yɛ̃.
Domi sɑnɑm mɛ ɡɔribɑ koo se, durɔbu kɑ kurɔbu bɑ ǹ mɑɑ suɑnɑmɔ, bɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe Gusunɔ wɔllun ɡɔrɑdobɑ.
Ye n mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡɔribun seebun ɡɑri, i ǹ ɡɑrire ye Gusunɔ u bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔwɑ? U nɛɛ,
nɛnɑ Gusunɔ Aburɑhɑmu kɑ Isɑki kɑ Yɑkɔbun Yinni. Gusunɔ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɑsobun Yinni, u ǹ sɑ̃ɑ ɡɔribun Yinni.
Tɔn wɔru ɡe ɡɑ ɡɑri yi nuɑ ɡɑ biti kuɑ win sɔ̃ɔsirun sɔ̃.
Woodɑ ye yɑ bo
Ye Fɑlisibɑ bɑ nuɑ mɑ Yesu u Sɑdusibɑ nɔɔ mwɑɑri, yerɑ bɑ mɛnnɑ.
Ben turo wi u sɑ̃ɑ woodɑ yɛ̃ro u kĩ u Yesun lɑɑkɑri mɛɛri, mɑ u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ,
tɔnwero, woodɑ yerɑ̀ yɑ kpɑ̃ɑru bo woodɑbɑ sɔɔ.
Yesu nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, “A Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinni kĩɔ kɑ wunɛn ɡɔ̃ru kpuro kɑ wunɛn bwɛ̃rɑ kpuro kɑ wunɛn bwisikunu kpuro.”
Yeyɑ yɑ sɑ̃ɑ woodɑ ɡbiikɑɑ, yerɑ yɑ mɑɑ kpɑ̃ɑru bo.
Yen yiruse wee, ye yɑ kɑ ye weenɛ yerɑ “A wunɛn tɔnusi kĩɔ nɡe wunɛn tii tii.”
Woodɑ yiru ye sɔɔn diyɑ Mɔwisin woodɑ kɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔbun sɔ̃ɔsinu kpuro yɑri.
Dɑfidi kɑ wi Gusunɔ u ɡɔsɑ
Ye Fɑlisibɑ bɑ mɛnnɛ, Yesu u bu ɡɑri yini bikiɑ.
U nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ i tɑmɑɑ wi Gusunɔ u ɡɔsɑ u sɑ̃ɑ. Weren bweserun diyɑ u yɑri. Bɑ nùn wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, Dɑfidin bweserun diyɑ.
Yesu bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ Dɑfidi kɑ nùn sokɑ Yinni kɑ Hunde Dɛɛron sɔ̃ɔsiru. Domi Dɑfidi ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: “Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛn Yinni sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
sere n kɑ nun wunɛn yibɛrɛbɑ tɑɑreɑ.”

content: Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, Dɑfidi ù n nùn sokɑ Yinni, ɑmɔnɑ u ko n kɑ kpɑm sɑ̃ɑ win bii.
Bɑɑ ben turo kun mɑɑ kpĩɑ u nùn ɡɛɛ wisi. Sɑɑ dɔmɑ ten di ɡoo kun mɑɑ nùn ɡɛɛ bikiɑre.
